passives.name: Prelude of the Waning Crescent
passives.description: (Passive Effect) Increases Critical Damage of the caster, and reduces Critical Hit Chance of Fire, Water, and Earth enemies. These effects cannot be removed. Increases the effectiveness of increased stat effects on the caster by [Buff_V_4076009_4_5]. When hit, does not take Weakness Gauge damage if the caster is not inflicted with a debuff. Recovers [Buff_V_4076009_4_3] Weakness Gauge upon scoring a critical hit on an enemy. Increases damage taken from Light enemies and reduces damage dealt to them. Reduces Weakness Gauge damage taken from non-Light enemies by [Buff_V_armor_common_1], increases damage dealt to them, and reduces damage taken from them. After scoring a critical hit, grants Harmony of Despair for [Buff_T_4076009_4_8] turn(s). Cursed/fixed damage taken by the Boss does not exceed [Buff_V_armor_common_3].

buffs.summary: −50% damage to boss if attacker has no element advantage/disadvantage
+15% damage to boss if attacker has element advantage
